segments.text: Queſt. 104th. What doth God require in the fifth Command?

Anſ. That I ſhew all Honour, Love, and Fidelity to my Father and Mother, and all in Authority over me, and ſubmit myſelf to their good Inſtruction and Correction, with due Obedience; and alſo patiently bear with their Weakneſſes and Infirmities, ſince it pleaſes God to govern us by their Hand.
